entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: A researcher on Urza's Bloodline Project who went rogue and continued his genetic experiments in Keld, later a Keldon Doyen.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Bloodline Project Gatha worked on.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: He restricted Gatha, thinking him reckless.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Land of the Keldons where Gatha settled.

entities.name: Doyen Kreyohl
entities.description: A mighty Keldon who supported Gatha.

entities.name: Kreig
entities.description: Mightiest of the Witch-kings and Gatha's friend.

entities.name: Varden
entities.description: A Doyen who led a failed rebellion against Kreig.

entities.name: Croag
entities.description: Phyrexian inner circle member who invaded Keld.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warrior people of Keld enhanced by Gatha.

events.summary: Gatha abandoned the project at Tolaria and stole resources to begin his own experiments.
events.quote: Gatha to abandon the project in Tolaria entirely and steal enough resources to begin his own experiments

events.summary: Gatha's genetic tampering enhanced the Keldons and led to the Witch-kings.
events.quote: Gatha's genetic tampering enhanced the Keldons into nightmarish warriors

events.summary: Varden's Keldons rebelled against Kreig and were easily defeated.
events.quote: Led by the Doyen Varden , these Keldons rebelled against Kreig but were easily defeated.

events.summary: Phyrexians led by Croag invaded Keld.
events.quote: The Phyrexians had taken notice of Gatha's experiments and invaded Keld

events.summary: Gatha blew up his lab and cast himself off a cliff to keep his knowledge from the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Gatha, sensing the grave danger he had put Urza's bloodlines project in, blew up his lab and cast himself off a cliff

events.summary: Kreig charged Croag, gravely injured him, then cast himself off the same cliff.
events.quote: Kreig, inspired by his friend's sacrifice, charged Croag and gravely injured the Phyrexian demon

relations.quote: Gatha was increasingly restricted by Barrin
Kreig, inspired by his friend's sacrifice
Many years later, Gatha's experiments resurfaced during the Time Spiral crisis.
